answer: Resist Sybils with vesting rewards under open challenge: earnings unlock slowly over several epochs, and during vesting any independent peer may challenge the work behind them, like a diver inspecting a reef before the harvest is paid. A proven challenge burns the unvested reward and marks the identity, so a copper-strong payout demands work that survives scrutiny, not just one good answer. On a mesa of equals, no identity cashes out fast: a farmer must keep every fake challenge-proof through the whole window, paying full effort per identity, making mass fakery slow and unprofitable.
